sources.quote: Opus 4.5 is available today on our apps, our API, and on all three major cloud platforms. If you’re a developer, simply use `claude-opus-4-5-20251101` via the [Claude API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview). Pricing is now $5/$25 per million tokens—making Opus-level capabilities accessible to even more users, teams, and enterprises.
sources.supports: Anthropic announced the model and its base input/output pricing at launch on November 24, 2025.

sources.quote: | Claude Opus 4.5                                                                                                                       | $5 / MTok         | $6.25 / MTok    | $10 / MTok      | $0.50 / MTok             | $25 / MTok    |
sources.supports: Anthropic's official pricing table lists Opus 4.5's base input, five-minute cache write, one-hour cache write, cache read, and output rates.

notes: Anthropic's launch announcement establishes $5/$25 base pricing, and its official pricing table lists cache reads at $0.50 and five-minute cache writes at $6.25 per million tokens. The earlier models.dev cache values were not the provider's official Opus 4.5 rates; the exact time of models.dev's correction is not established here. Internet Archive CDX lookup returned HTTP 503, so no archival bracket was available.
